metadata.description: Kouji's Claude plugins: the house rules for how we design and build, shared by every project.

plugins.name: kouji-design
plugins.description: Every design lives in the project's design/ folder and runs both locally and on a Claude Design canvas: an interactive page and a components page per app, every component in one bundle, a Design System artifact for tokens, Preact signals, no build step. Brings in Anthropic's design, engineering and frontend-design plugins.
